statements.chinese: 所以我觉得我可以当个“玩蛇的疯子”。

statements.english: Crazy Snake Man
Then I'll get more snakes , call them my babies
statements.chinese: 那我就养更多的蛇，把它们都当作我的宝贝。

statements.english: Kids will run past my place ! they will run
statements.chinese: 孩子们会跑过我的住处！他们会跑起来的。

statements.english: " Run away from Crazy Snake Man ," they'll shout !
statements.chinese: “快逃开那个疯狂的蛇男！”他们会这样喊道！
